issue.title: Agent cleanup cannot serialize EpicFollowView entries in wait_epic_follows
issue.description: Pure in-memory reproduction on workspace 1592f4dbc; serializer unchanged versus installed 2648c7cdd. The serializer encodes certain field types but passes the nested list of EpicFollowView dataclasses through unchanged. Add an explicit schema-preserving encoder for these entries and a corresponding round-trip decoder. Preserve target/state/epic_ids/added_bead_ids/members/since/reason/detail/resume_command/skipped_epic_ids. Do not default=str or drop the field. Cover empty and populated entries plus complete cleanup request JSON encoding. sase-104 is adjacent (request size), not the same cause. Medium scope because the broken boundary and minimal reproduction are known.

task_type_fields.impact: Cleanup/dismissal for affected agents fails before the durable operation starts. Bundle persistence shares the broken encoder.
task_type_fields.repro: Apollo ~/.sase/logs/tui.log records four agent.cleanup submission failures on 2026-10-20 (10:26:00, 11:00:59, 11:07:37, 11:35:45 raw logger time). Construct an Agent with start_time=datetime(...), wait_epic_follows=[EpicFollowView(target="fixture.land", state="following", epic_ids=("fixture-1",))]; json.dumps(agent_state_to_bundle_dict(agent)) and json.dumps(serialize_agent(agent)) both raise TypeError: Object of type EpicFollowView is not JSON serializable.

issue.creation_reason: A cross-machine production log audit found independently reproducible failures that need durable follow-up.

evidence.note: Reproduced on apollo at sase master 9188cc5733: both serialize_agent and agent_state_to_bundle_dict raise TypeError for a populated wait_epic_follows. The blast radius is wider than one agent. Kill and dismiss payloads also serialize the whole agents_with_children snapshot (_kill_procs.py:96 and :187, _dismissing.py:282 and :439). So while any loaded agent has an epic follow (apollo currently has 95.w1 with wait_for_epics_of=['95']), kill and dismiss likely fail for every agent in that TUI.
